title.narrative: Rapid response to contain cholera outbreak in Somaliland, Puntland, Central and Southern States of Somalia

description.narrative: The overall goal of this WHO project is to contain the cholera outbreak in Somalia by stopping active transmission and preventing a large-scale outbreak in urban settings through evidence-based interventions as contained in the activities below. WHO and its partners implements expansion of the disease surveillance network, builds the capacity of health workers to identify and treat cholera cases, procurement, and distributes of cholera kits, sets up of oral rehydration points, and procures and distributes of laboratory diagnostic reagents, printing and distribution of job aids, protocols etc, and conduct of supportive supervisory visits in collaboration with the ministries of health.A total of 21,200 people, including 10,600 women and girls and 3,180 persons with disabilities, are expected to directly benefit from these interventionshe overall goal of this WHO project is to contain the cholera outbreak in Somalia by halting active transmission and preventing a large-scale outbreak in urban settings through evidence-based interventions outlined in the activities below. WHO and its partners implement the expansion of the disease surveillance network, capacity building of health workers to identify and treat cholera cases, procurement and distribution of cholera kits, establishment of oral rehydration points, procurement and distribution of laboratory diagnostic reagents, as well as printing and distribution of job aids, protocols, etc. Additionally, supportive supervisory visits are conducted in collaboration with the ministries of health. A total of 21,200 people, including 10,600 women and girls, and 3,180 persons with disabilities, are expected to directly benefit from these interventions.
